title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2608.14071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models scale, their training-token budgets must also increase to maintain an appropriate tokens-per-parameter ratio (\(\mathrm{TPP}\)). However, high-quality domain data is much harder to scale than general web data. As model size and the training-token budget increase, its fraction in the training mixture tends to decrease. Repeating the available high-quality data provides an effective way to counteract this dilution, but excessive repetition may lead to overfitting. We study this trade-off under practical LLM scaling, where the training-token budget grows proportionally with model size. For a fixed domain, we first find that, surprisingly at a fixed \(\mathrm{TPP}\), the optimal repetition count mildly increases with model size. Across different domains, we find that the optimal repetition count is strongly negatively correlated with the final validation loss of a domain: domains with lower loss can generally benefit

translated_title: 大型语言模型预训练中领域数据重复的扩展研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14071v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着大型语言模型的扩展，其训练令牌预算也必须增加，以维持适当的令牌-参数比（\(\mathrm{TPP}\)）。然而，高质量领域数据比通用网络数据更难扩展。随着模型大小和训练令牌预算的增加，其在训练混合中的比例往往趋于下降。重复使用可用的高质量数据提供了一种有效的方法来抵消这种稀释效应，但过度重复可能导致过拟合。我们在实际的大型语言模型扩展场景下研究这一权衡，其中训练令牌预算随模型大小成比例增长。对于固定领域，我们首先发现，令人惊讶的是，在固定的\(\mathrm{TPP}\)下，最佳重复次数随模型大小轻微增加。跨不同领域，我们发现最佳重复次数与领域的最终验证损失强烈负相关：损失较低的领域通常能受益于更多重复。
tldr: 该论文发现，在大型语言模型预训练中，最佳领域数据重复次数随模型规模温和增加，并与领域验证损失负相关，从而为高质量数据稀释问题提供了优化策略。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that the optimal repetition count of domain data in LLM pretraining mildly increases with model scale and is negatively correlated with domain validation loss, offering a strategy to counteract high-quality data dilution.
